title: Project-Based Web Developer
description: Began contributing during the BBPVP Bekasi On-the-Job Training phase and continued in a paid project-based role. Maintain, refine, and improve assigned websites while protecting the confidentiality of the client, systems, and deliverables.
highlights: Improve visual consistency and refine website interfaces.
Adjust responsive layouts, page structure, and user experience.
Resolve bugs and implement changes through assigned review and revision cycles.
Protect confidential website identities, data, source code, and internal systems.

title: Freelance Daily Worker & Operations Staff
description: Have taken on call-based and shift-based operational work since 2021. Currently work at a parcel distribution center in Cakung while preparing to transition into a full-time information technology role.
highlights: Internet café attendant: assisted customers, handled basic computer issues, and maintained the work area.
Warehouse and sorting staff: supported loading, stock arrangement, and parcel sorting by delivery area.
Market laborer: unloaded and arranged goods from trucks and box vans for agents and merchants.
Light construction worker: assisted with basic building tasks and kept project areas clean.
Hotel laundry staff: washed, folded, and prepared linen for daily delivery.
Ice block production worker: removed finished ice and loaded refrigerated vehicles for distribution.
Kitchen assistant: cleaned equipment, prepared additional ingredients, and supported food plating.
Developed discipline, responsibility, adaptability, communication, and teamwork in shift- and deadline-driven environments.
